content.short: Clober provides cutting-edge infrastructure for decentralized exchanges (dexs), empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Fully on-chain order book exchange for efficient trading. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Clober redefines how users interact with decentralized exchanges (dexs). The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Ethereum and Base and Arbitrum and Polygon to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Clober stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
